# Order confirmation emails. Sent by the worker in jobs/send_mail.py.

from shop.orders import Order

SENDER = "shop@example.com"


def subject(o):
    return "Ihre Bestellung " + o.number + " ist eingegangen"


def confirmation_body(o: Order) -> str:
    s = "Hallo " + o.customer_name + ",\n\n"
    s += "vielen Dank für Ihre Bestellung " + o.number + ".\n\n"
    s += "Sie haben bestellt:\n"
    for it in o.items:
        s += "  " + str(it.quantity) + " x " + it.name + "\n"
    s += "\n"
    s += "Wir melden uns, sobald Ihre Bestellung versandt wurde.\n\n"
    s += "Viele Grüße\nIhr Shop-Team\n"
    return s


def is_sendable(o):
    if o.customer_email == None or o.customer_email == "":
        return False
    if not "@" in o.customer_email:
        return False
    return True

11	    sku: str

13	    unit_price: Decimal  # net
14	    quantity: int

16	
17	    def net(self) -> Decimal:
18	        return self.unit_price * self.quantity
19	
20	    def vat(self) -> Decimal:
21	        # Our tax advisor requires VAT to be rounded per line, not on the order total.
22	        return round_cents(self.net() * VAT_RATES[self.vat_class])
23

26	class Order:
27	    number: str
28	    customer_name: str
29	    customer_email: str
30	    items: list[LineItem] = field(default_factory=list)
31	    shipping: Decimal = Decimal("0")  # gross, no VAT split

34	def net_total(order: Order) -> Decimal:
35	    return sum((item.net() for item in order.items), Decimal("0"))
36

39	    return sum((item.vat() for item in order.items), Decimal("0"))

"""Money helpers. Amounts are always Decimal, never float."""

from decimal import ROUND_HALF_UP, Decimal

CENT = Decimal("0.01")
_TO_GERMAN_SEPARATORS = str.maketrans({",": ".", ".": ","})


def round_cents(amount: Decimal) -> Decimal:
    return amount.quantize(CENT, rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP)


def format_eur(amount: Decimal) -> str:
    """Format the way German invoices do: 1.234,50 EUR."""
    us_style = f"{round_cents(amount):,.2f}"
    return f"{us_style.translate(_TO_GERMAN_SEPARATORS)} EUR"
